def Selection.map {W : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (S : Selection G) (e : G ≃g H) : Selection H where
  root v := e (S.root (e.symm v))
  reachable v := by
    have h := (S.reachable (e.symm v)).map e.toHom
    change H.Reachable (e (e.symm v)) (e (S.root (e.symm v))) at h
    simpa only [RelIso.apply_symm_apply] using h
  constant h := congrArg e (S.constant (h.map e.symm.toHom))

def AugmentationTrace {n K : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)

  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →

def tick (A : RandomMachine) (c : Configuration A) (bit : Bool) : Configuration A :=
  match c.state with
  | none => c
  | some s => match A.transition s c.tape.head bit with
    | none => ⟨none, c.tape⟩
    | some (s', action) =>
      ⟨some s', match action with
        | .move d => c.tape.move d
        | .write a => c.tape.write a⟩

  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,

/-- A rational encoded by its reduced numerator and positive denominator. -/
structure Configuration (A : RandomMachine) where
  state : Option (Fin (A.states + 1))
  tape : Turing.Tape Symbol

/-- A halted configuration is absorbing. Each nonhalting tick is exactly one
write or one move, or the detection of halt. -/
def tick (A : RandomMachine) (c : Configuration A) (bit : Bool) : Configuration A :=
  match c.state with
  | none => c
  | some s => match A.transition s c.tape.head bit with
    | none => ⟨none, c.tape⟩
    | some (s', action) =>
      ⟨some s', match action with
        | .move d => c.tape.move d
        | .write a => c.tape.write a⟩

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,
      (f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (f₂ y) ^ t ≤ f₀ ((1 - t) • x + t • y)) →
    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤

    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧

    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,

    MaximumForest.weight F (capacity b)≤MaximumForest.weight T (capacity b)
  r : I → ℤ

  X : I → J → ℤ
  d : ℕ
  W : ℕ
  hd : 1≤d
  hcard : Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J≤d
  hW : 2≤W
  hlarge : ∀ i j, small i j=false → W≤b i j ∧ 1≤b i j
  hsmall : ∀ i j, small i j=true → b i j<W

def EdmondsKarp1972Theorem1 : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : Capacity n), (∀ u, c u u=0) →
    ∀ (s t : Fin n), s≠t →
      ∀ (K : ℕ) (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n),

def HasMargins (X : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, ∑ j, X i j = r i) ∧ (∀ j, ∑ i, X i j = c j)

capacity bound and skew symmetry give both directed residual bounds. -/

def AugmentationTrace {n K : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (F : Fin (K+1) → Flow n) : Prop :=
  F 0=0 ∧
  (∀ i, Feasible c s t (F i)) ∧
  ∀ i : Fin K, ShortestAugmentation c s t (F i.castSucc) (F i.succ)

/-- The shortest-augmenting-path bound for integral skew flows.
Every finite initial segment has at most n³ augmentations, independently
of the rule used to break ties between shortest paths. -/
def computedFlow (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (b : Fin m → Fin n → ℕ) :

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧

  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

def HasMargins (X : I → J → ℕ) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) : Prop :=

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧

abbrev Input := ((ℕ×ℕ)×List Term)×ℕ

def intervalCode (z : Input) : TreeFraction.Fraction :=

def parts (z : Input) : ℕ×ℕ :=

def data (offset : ℤ) (coefficient : Fin q → ℤ) (v : Fin q → ℕ) (den : ℕ) : Input :=
  ((signedParts offset,List.ofFn (fun i => (signedParts (coefficient i),v i))),den)

noncomputable def offset (A : Instance I J) (S : Selection A.T)
    (t : TreeCell A.T) (x q : I → J → ℤ) : ℤ :=
  A.X t.val.1 t.val.2-smallContribution A S t x q*sign A S t t.val-
    ∑ a : I×J,coefficient A S t a*A.X a.1 a.2

noncomputable def coefficient (A : Instance I J) (S : Selection A.T)
    (t : TreeCell A.T) (a : I×J) : ℤ :=
  if A.small a.1 a.2=false ∧ ¬A.T.Adj (.inl a.1) (.inr a.2)
  then -(sign A S t a)*sign A S t t.val else 0

def cellAdj (small : I → J → Bool) : I⊕J → I⊕J → Prop
  | .inl i,.inr j => small i j=false
  | .inr j,.inl i => small i j=false
  | _,_ => False

def w : Expr := .input 1
def plus (z : Signed×Signed) : Signed := (z.1.1+z.2.1,z.1.2+z.2.2)
def times (z : Signed×Signed) : Signed :=
  (z.1.1*z.2.1+z.1.2*z.2.2,z.1.1*z.2.2+z.1.2*z.2.1)
abbrev Term := (ℕ×ℕ)×ℕ
abbrev Input := (ℕ×ℕ)×ℕ

def numerator (z : Input) : ℕ := (z.1.2-z.1.1)+(z.1.1-(z.1.2+z.2))

def positiveTerm (z : Term) : ℕ := z.1.1*z.2
def sum (xs : List Signed) : Signed := ((xs.map Prod.fst).sum,(xs.map Prod.snd).sum)

def negativeTerm (z : Term) : ℕ := z.1.2*z.2

def signedParts (z : ℤ) : ℕ×ℕ := (z.toNat,(-z).toNat)

noncomputable def smallContribution (A : Instance I J) (S : Selection A.T)
    (t : TreeCell A.T) (x q : I → J → ℤ) : ℤ :=
  ∑ a : I×J,if A.small a.1 a.2 then
    integerIndicator (RootedCut.treeCut A.T S t (.inl a.1))*(x a.1 a.2-A.X a.1 a.2)-
      integerIndicator (RootedCut.treeCut A.T S t (.inr a.2))*(q a.1 a.2-A.X a.1 a.2) else 0

noncomputable def sign (A : Instance I J) (S : Selection A.T)
    (t : TreeCell A.T) (a : I×J) : ℤ :=
  integerIndicator (RootedCut.treeCut A.T S t (.inl a.1))-
    integerIndicator (RootedCut.treeCut A.T S t (.inr a.2))

abbrev Signed := ℕ×ℕ

def integerIndicator (b : Bool) : ℤ := if b then 1 else 0

noncomputable def treeCut (T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J)) (S : Selection T)
    (t : TreeCell T) (v : I⊕J) : Bool :=
  cut T (.inl t.val.1) (.inr t.val.2) (S.root (.inl t.val.1)) v

noncomputable def cut (T : SimpleGraph V) (u v root a : V) : Bool :=
  side (T.deleteEdges {s(u,v)}) (away T u v root) a

noncomputable def side (D : SimpleGraph V) (u v : V) : Bool := decide (D.Reachable u v)

omit [Fintype V] in
noncomputable def away (T : SimpleGraph V) (u v root : V) : V :=
  if (T.deleteEdges {s(u,v)}).Reachable u root then v else u

  root v := e (S.root (e.symm v))
  reachable v := by
    have h := (S.reachable (e.symm v)).map e.toHom
    change H.Reachable (e (e.symm v)) (e (S.root (e.symm v))) at h
    simpa only [RelIso.apply_symm_apply] using h
  constant h := congrArg e (S.constant (h.map e.symm.toHom))

def largePadding (K : Finset (I × J)) (L : ℕ) : I → J → ℕ :=
  fun i j => if (i, j) ∈ K then L else 0

private theorem large_padding_good_card (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ)
    (K : Finset (I × J)) (L : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card {Y : Table (paddedRows r (largePadding K L))
        (paddedColumns c (largePadding K L)) //
      ¬∃ p : K, Y.val p.val.1 p.val.2 < L} = Fintype.card (Table r c) := by
  let P := largePadding K L
  let T := Table (paddedRows r P) (paddedColumns c P)
  have heq (Y : T) : (¬∃ p : K, Y.val p.val.1 p.val.2 < L) ↔
      ∀ i j, P i j ≤ Y.val i j := by
    constructor
    · intro hb i j
      by_cases hij : (i, j) ∈ K
      · have hn : ¬Y.val i j < L := fun h => hb ⟨⟨(i, j), hij⟩, h⟩
        simpa [P, largePadding, hij] using (show L ≤ Y.val i j by omega)
      · simp [P, largePadding, hij]
    · intro hg
      rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
      have h := hg p.val.1 p.val.2
      have hm : (p.val.1, p.val.2) ∈ K := p.property
      simp only [P, largePadding, hm, ite_true] at h
      omega
  have he : {Y : T // ¬∃ p : K, Y.val p.val.1 p.val.2 < L} ≃
      {Y : T // ∀ i j, P i j ≤ Y.val i j} := Equiv.subtypeEquivRight heq
  rw [Fintype.card_congr he]
  exact successful_card r c P

/-- The successful enlarged-table fraction is bounded using the proved
small-entry estimate and the exact padding bijection. This is the counting

def CompletionFibre (small : I → J → Bool) (B : I → J → ℕ)
    (r rbar : I → ℕ) (c cbar : J → ℕ) (z : SmallProfile small) :=
  {Z : RowColumnPair rbar cbar //
    (∀ i, smallRow small Z.val.1 i ≤ r i) ∧
    (∀ j, smallColumnView small Z.val.2 j ≤ c j) ∧
    (∀ i j (hs : small i j=true),
      Z.val.1 i j=z (⟨(i,j),hs⟩,false) ∧
      Z.val.2 i j=B i j-z (⟨(i,j),hs⟩,true)) ∧
    (∀ i j, small i j=false → Z.val.1 i j=Z.val.2 i j) ∧
    (∀ i j, small i j=false → Z.val.1 i j ≤ B i j)}

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,
      (f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (f₂ y) ^ t ≤ f₀ ((1 - t) • x + t • y)) →
    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤

        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,
      (f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (f₂ y) ^ t ≤ f₀ ((1 - t) • x + t • y)) →
    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤
      ∫ z in S₀, f₀ z

        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,
      (f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (f₂ y) ^ t ≤ f₀ ((1 - t) • x + t • y)) →
    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤

        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

def FiniteBoxPrekopaLeindler (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → t < 1 →
  ∀ (lower upper : Point q) (S₀ S₁ S₂ : Set (Point q))
    (f₀ f₁ f₂ : Point q → ℝ),
    IsFiniteBoxUnion S₀ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₁ → IsFiniteBoxUnion S₂ →
    closure S₀ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₁ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    closure S₂ ⊆ Set.Icc lower upper →
    ContinuousOn f₀ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₁ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    ContinuousOn f₂ (Set.Icc lower upper) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₀ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₁ x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lower upper, 0 < f₂ x) →
    interpolate t S₁ S₂ ⊆ S₀ →
    (∀ x ∈ S₁, ∀ y ∈ S₂,
      (f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (f₂ y) ^ t ≤ f₀ ((1 - t) • x + t • y)) →
    (∫ x in S₁, f₁ x) ^ (1 - t) * (∫ y in S₂, f₂ y) ^ t ≤
      ∫ z in S₀, f₀ z

/-- Log-concavity is needed only on the common ambient box. -/
def FiniteCheeger : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : FiniteChain X) (κ : ℝ), 0 < κ →
    (∀ S : Finset X,
      κ * min (∑ x ∈ S, C.π x) (∑ x ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x) ≤
        ∑ x ∈ S, ∑ y ∈ Sᶜ, C.π x * C.P x y) →
    ∀ f : X → ℝ, C.variance f ≤ (2 / κ ^ 2) * C.energy f

end

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)

  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

def mapLaw [DecidableEq β] (p : RationalLaw α) (f : α → β) : RationalLaw β where
  mass := fun y => ∑ x, if f x = y then p.mass x else 0
  nonnegative := fun y => Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => by
    split_ifs

  total := by

  mass := fun z => p.mass z.1 * q.mass z.2

def Feasible {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n) (f : Flow n) : Prop :=
  (∀ u v, f u v= -f v u) ∧
  (∀ u v, f u v≤c u v) ∧
  (∀ u, u≠s → u≠t → (∑ v, f u v)=0)

def ShortestAugmentation {n : ℕ} (c : Capacity n) (s t : Fin n)
    (f g : Flow n) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k : ℕ) (p : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (a : ℤ),
    ResidualPath c f s t k p ∧
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (q : Fin (l+1) → Fin n), ResidualPath c f s t l q → k≤l) ∧
    0<a ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, a≤(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    (∃ i : Fin k, a=(c (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ):ℤ)-f (p i.castSucc) (p i.succ)) ∧
    ∀ u v, g u v=f u v+a*((∑ i : Fin k,
      if p i.castSucc=u ∧ p i.succ=v then (1:ℤ) else 0)-
      (∑ i : Fin k, if p i.castSucc=v ∧ p i.succ=u then (1:ℤ) else 0))

    (initial : PlainIndex (pairs : List (Pair A)) → ℝ) :
    ℕ → PlainIndex (pairs : List (Pair A)) → ℝ
  | 0 => initial
  | j+1 => ((returnKernel A R C K (j+1) k n hK hW xi v (w (j+1))).power
      (restartTime A H L)).push (implemented A R C K H L k n hK hW xi v w initial j)

/-- Every new stage starts from a four-warm exact reference. Errors of
the actual bounded-word implementation add, without conditioning on a
successful return or requiring its incoming distribution to be warm. -/
def tableReindex (eI : I' ≃ I) (eJ : J' ≃ J) (r : I → ℕ) (c : J → ℕ) :
    Table r c ≃ Table (fun i => r (eI i)) (fun j => c (eJ j)) where
  toFun X := ⟨fun i j => X.val (eI i) (eJ j),
    fun i => (eJ.sum_comp (X.val (eI i))).trans (X.property.1 (eI i)),
    fun j => (eI.sum_comp (fun i => X.val i (eJ j))).trans (X.property.2 (eJ j))⟩
  invFun X := ⟨fun i j => X.val (eI.symm i) (eJ.symm j),by
    constructor
    · intro i
      rw [eJ.symm.sum_comp]
      simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using X.property.1 (eI.symm i)
    · intro j
      exact (eI.symm.sum_comp (fun i => X.val i (eJ.symm j))).trans (by
        simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using X.property.2 (eJ.symm j))⟩
  left_inv X := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i j
    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  right_inv X := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i j
    simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

end ContingencyTables

def table {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ)
    (htotal : (∑ i,r i)=∑ j,c j) : Table r c := ⟨matrix r c,matrix_hasMargins r c htotal⟩

abbrev Input := (List Bool×ℕ)×(List ℕ×ℕ)

def Selection.map {W : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (S : Selection G) (e : G ≃g H) : Selection H where
  root v := e (S.root (e.symm v))
  reachable v := by
    have h := (S.reachable (e.symm v)).map e.toHom
    change H.Reachable (e (e.symm v)) (e (S.root (e.symm v))) at h
    simpa only [RelIso.apply_symm_apply] using h
  constant h := congrArg e (S.constant (h.map e.symm.toHom))

structure Instance where
  small : I → J → Bool
  b : I → J → ℕ
  T : SimpleGraph (I⊕J)
  hTG : T≤cellGraph small
  hT : T.IsAcyclic
  hmax : ∀ F : SimpleGraph (I⊕J), F≤cellGraph small → F.IsAcyclic →
    MaximumForest.weight F (capacity b)≤MaximumForest.weight T (capacity b)
  r : I → ℤ
  c : J → ℤ
  X : I → J → ℤ
  d : ℕ
  W : ℕ
  hd : 1≤d
  hcard : Fintype.card I*Fintype.card J≤d
  hW : 2≤W
  hlarge : ∀ i j, small i j=false → W≤b i j ∧ 1≤b i j
  hsmall : ∀ i j, small i j=true → b i j<W
  hX : ∀ i j, 0≤X i j ∧ X i j≤b i j
  hXr : ∀ i, (∑ j, X i j)=r i
  hXc : ∀ j, (∑ i, X i j)=c j

variable {I J}

def rationalCoefficient (A : Instance I J) (t : TreeCell A.T) (a : I×J) : ℚ :=
  if A.small a.1 a.2=false ∧ ¬A.T.Adj (.inl a.1) (.inr a.2)
  then -rationalSign A t a/rationalSign A t t.val else 0

def small (b : Fin m→Fin n→ℕ) (W : ℕ) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) : Bool :=
  decide (b i j<W)

def cellGraph (small : I → J → Bool) : SimpleGraph (I⊕J) where
  Adj := cellAdj small
  symm := ⟨by intro v w; cases v <;> cases w <;> exact id⟩
  loopless := ⟨by intro v; cases v <;> exact id⟩

noncomputable def weight (G : SimpleGraph V) (b : Sym2 V → ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, b e

def rationalSign (A : Instance I J) (t : TreeCell A.T) (a : I×J) : ℚ :=
  rationalIndicator (cutSide A t (.inl a.1))-rationalIndicator (cutSide A t (.inr a.2))

def cellAdj (small : I → J → Bool) : I⊕J → I⊕J → Prop
  | .inl i,.inr j => small i j=false
  | .inr j,.inl i => small i j=false
  | _,_ => False

def w : Expr := .input 1
def rationalIndicator (b : Bool) : ℚ := if b then 1 else 0

noncomputable def cutSide (A : Instance I J) (t : TreeCell A.T) (v : I⊕J) : Bool :=
  side (A.T.deleteEdges {edge t.val}) (cutVertex A t) v

inductive Expr where
  | input : ℕ → Expr
  | number : ℕ → Expr
  | plus : Expr → Expr → Expr
  | times : Expr → Expr → Expr

noncomputable def side (D : SimpleGraph V) (u v : V) : Bool := decide (D.Reachable u v)

omit [Fintype V] in
noncomputable def edge (t : I×J) : Sym2 (I⊕J) := s(Sum.inl t.1,Sum.inr t.2)

noncomputable def cutVertex (A : Instance I J) (t : TreeCell A.T) : I⊕J :=
  Classical.choose (exists_root_avoiding_side A.T A.hT t.property
    (componentRoot A.T (.inl t.val.1)) (componentRoot_reachable A.T (.inl t.val.1)).symm)

def plus (z : Signed×Signed) : Signed := (z.1.1+z.2.1,z.1.2+z.2.2)
def times (z : Signed×Signed) : Signed :=
  (z.1.1*z.2.1+z.1.2*z.2.2,z.1.1*z.2.2+z.1.2*z.2.1)
noncomputable def componentRoot (G : SimpleGraph V) (v : V) : V :=
  Classical.choose (G.connectedComponentMk v).exists_rep
